The '''Ukunuku Night Herald''' was a [[Killik/Legends|Killik]] that held the position of [[Night Herald]] within the [[Ukunuku]] nest on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. The Killik was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in the [[Lanthanide mine]] in the [[Juran Mountains/Legends|Juran Mountains]].
